record.question: Medical Records have three major sections, the second section is :
record.explanation: Answer C: Sociological section. In the traditional three-section description of a medical record, the second is the sociological section. Source/context note: This is a legacy textbook classification, not a universal modern record schema. Reference: https://iris.who.int/bitstream/handle/10665/208125/9290610050_rev_eng.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
